We carry out national and international research and development projects in cooperation with research institutions and businesses. Within the Horizon Europe-funded MOBILES project, we investigate the environmental safety of genetically modified organisms used in biological biosensors. Our work covers microbiological, molecular and environmental research as well as risk assessments…
